run: OmniVoice adapted to Persian by its official recipe, on Kaggle T4 pairs
status: sessions a and b complete: 3,000 of 5,000 steps trained; session c waits for the weekly quota reset on 2026-09-26

recipe.source: k2-fsa/OmniVoice 08be0b4ccbac3e13e374e86fbfead4b4cac343e2, examples/config/train_config_finetune_sdpa.json (git blob 4b0a543e23be), fetched and checked in every session
recipe.values: lr 1e-5, AdamW weight decay 0.01, cosine schedule with 1% warmup, 5,000 steps, 8,192 tokens per GPU on two GPUs, no gradient accumulation, gradient norm clip 1.0, bf16 mixed precision, language_ratio 0.8, prompt ratio 0-0.3, mask ratio 0-1, condition drop 0.1, codebook weights [8,8,6,6,4,4,2,2], seed 42, evaluation and checkpoint every 500 steps
recipe.data: eval/manifests/adaptation_splits_v1.jsonl.gz: train 87,499 clips, 127.85 h, 3,835 speakers (Common Voice 26 cleaned + Neyshekar v6); valid 2,251 clips, 3.68 h; language_id fa
changes_on_this_hardware: gradient checkpointing on the LLM and DDP gradient_as_bucket_view - memory only; probe v2 showed the same first loss and first-step gradients as the official path
base and tokenizer loaded from local snapshots of their pinned revisions
keep_last_n_checkpoints 1 and a float16 export every 1,000 steps - retention, not training
sessions stop after an official checkpoint and resume through the official resume_from_checkpoint, which restarts the data order at the first epoch

reading_fixed_before_the_run: SOTA_ROADMAP.md section 8: the exports at 1,000-5,000 steps are scored on the development set beside the published model in one session; the one with the highest held-out similarity whose CER interval against the published model does not lie above zero is the candidate; only that candidate and the published model are then scored, once, on the sealed test sets (primary: the 28 usable Neyshekar test speakers; secondary: the 30 Common Voice ones), H0 delta <= 0, one-sided alpha 0.025. The training losses are not a quality result, and no improvement is claimed before the test comparison
